context_basis: Read all initial16 and final12 proposals with English/source context; checked actual current XML absence and Kotlin references.
Assembly add bounds state.size+items.size<=20; empty state is allowed. Symbolic0–20 count avoids unsubstantiated relative-quantity vocabulary.
Placement wording locates image on workspace; unplace says remove from workspace only, distinct from deleting assembly item or source file.
Page index and count are separate values. Corrected display labels explicitly distinguish nanpa (index) and mute (total count). Range prompt keeps numeric endpoints1..maximum.
Attachment anchor and crop decoder distinctions remain unaccepted individually, not by blanket language exclusion.
Reopen label uses established kulupu sitelen caption; unavailable corrected to inability to use rather than nonexistence.
limits: Moderate independent AI/source acceptance for11UIvalues only

Independent applied-resource verification, not native-speaker certification.
